```
(Currently Amended) Claim 26: A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil including phosphatidylcholine, wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID or a salicylic acid NSAID, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved.

(Currently Amended) Claim 50: A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and salicylic acid NSAID, said salicylic acid NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylic acid NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5.

(Currently Amended) Claim 51: The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
```
